fete--noun.def: An outdoor event with stalls and games, often for charity.
fete--noun.ex: The village fete raised two thousand pounds.
fete--noun.exTr: Köy şenliği iki bin sterlin topladı.

bereft--adj.def: Left without something important that has been taken away.
bereft--adj.ex: He was bereft of all support.

procedural--adj.def: Relating to the correct order of official steps.
procedural--adj.ex: The appeal failed on procedural grounds.

procedural--noun.def: A drama that follows police or legal work step by step.
procedural--noun.ex: The channel shows a nightly procedural.
procedural--noun.exTr: Kanal her akşam bir polisiye usul dizisi gösteriyor.

redundancy--noun.def: The loss of a job no longer needed, or needless repetition.

primeval--adj.def: Belonging to the earliest ages of the world.
primeval--adj.ex: Primeval forest still covers the slope.

interlude--noun.def: A short period between two longer ones.
interlude--noun.ex: The war was a brief interlude of peace.

fabled--adj.def: Famous in stories, and perhaps not quite real.
fabled--adj.ex: They searched for the fabled city.

posturing--noun.def: Behaviour meant to impress rather than to achieve anything.

parasitic--adj.def: Living off another creature, or taking without giving back.
parasitic--adj.ex: The worm leads a parasitic life.

hapless--adj.def: Unlucky and unable to change the situation.
hapless--adj.ex: The hapless driver missed the turn.

mariner--noun.def: A sailor, especially in older or formal use.
mariner--noun.ex: An old mariner told the story.

austere--adj.def: Very plain and without comfort, or strict in manner.
austere--adj.ex: The room was clean and austere.

feign--verb.def: To pretend to have a feeling or condition.
feign--verb.ex: She feigned surprise at the news.

quirk--verb.def: To twist the lips or an eyebrow into a brief expression.
quirk--verb.ex: He quirked an eyebrow at me.

ferocity--noun.ex: The storm struck with sudden ferocity.

parable--noun.def: A short story that teaches a moral lesson.

abhor--verb.def: To hate something because you find it morally wrong.
abhor--verb.ex: She abhors all forms of cruelty.

cloister--noun.def: A covered walk around a courtyard in a monastery.
cloister--noun.ex: Monks walked the cloister at dawn.

shoal--noun.def: A large group of fish, or a shallow patch of water.
shoal--noun.ex: A shoal of herring passed below.

angular--adj.def: Having sharp corners, or thin with bones that show.

synthesis--noun.def: The combining of separate parts into one whole.
synthesis--noun.ex: The book is a synthesis of both views.

rickety--adj.def: Weak and likely to break or fall apart.

romp--verb.def: To play noisily, or to win very easily.

subsidy--noun.def: Money paid by a government to keep prices low.

euphoric--adj.def: Feeling an intense happiness that will not last.
euphoric--adj.ex: Fans were euphoric after the final.

verbatim--adj.def: Repeating the exact words that were used.

proportional--adj.def: Changing in size or amount in line with something else.
proportional--adj.ex: The fine is proportional to income.

deficient--adj.def: Not having enough of something needed.
deficient--adj.ex: The soil is deficient in iron.

instantaneously--adv.def: At once, with no time passing at all.

glint--verb.def: To give out small bright flashes of light.
glint--verb.ex: Broken glass glinted on the road.

virtuoso--noun.def: A performer with exceptional technical skill.
virtuoso--noun.ex: The pianist is a true virtuoso.

delicatessen--noun.def: A shop selling cheeses, cooked meats and fine foods.
delicatessen--noun.ex: Buy the olives at the delicatessen.

materialize--verb.def: To become real, or to appear suddenly.

vocational--adj.def: Training people for a particular trade or job.

hitherto--adv.def: Up to this point in time, in formal use.
hitherto--adv.ex: Hitherto the law had been ignored.

repute--noun.def: The general opinion people hold of someone.
repute--noun.ex: She is a scholar of great repute.
repute--noun.exTr: Büyük itibar sahibi bir bilim insanı.

arcane--adj.def: Understood by only a few because it is old or obscure.
arcane--adj.ex: The rules are arcane and long.

verily--adv.def: Truly, used in old religious or literary language.

gauche--adj.def: Awkward in social situations and lacking polish.

regulatory--adj.def: Relating to official rules that control an industry.
regulatory--adj.ex: A regulatory body reviews the fees.

fruition--noun.def: The point at which a plan finally produces results.
fruition--noun.ex: The project came to fruition last year.

painstaking--adj.def: Done with great care and taking much effort.

dispersal--noun.def: The spreading of people or things over a wide area.
dispersal--noun.ex: Wind aids the dispersal of seeds.

retrospective--adj.def: Looking back at past events, or applying to earlier ones.
retrospective--adj.ex: The raise is retrospective to January.
retrospective--adj.exTr: Zam ocak ayına kadar geriye dönük.

substantiate--verb.def: To provide evidence that proves a claim.
substantiate--verb.ex: He could not substantiate the charge.

fluctuation--noun.def: A repeated rise and fall in level or amount.

lurid--adj.def: Shockingly detailed, or unpleasantly bright in colour.

nonchalant--adj.def: Calm in a way that suggests you do not care.

prostrate--verb.def: To lie face down, usually to show respect.

prostrate--adj.def: Lying flat on the ground, or completely exhausted.
prostrate--adj.ex: We found him prostrate on the floor.

reclusive--adj.def: Living alone and avoiding contact with others.

chrysalis--noun.def: The hard case in which a caterpillar becomes a butterfly.
chrysalis--noun.ex: A chrysalis hung under the leaf.

curate--verb.def: To select and organise items for a collection or show.

opaque--adj.def: Impossible to see through, or hard to understand.

irrevocable--adj.def: Impossible to change or cancel once done.

constrained--adj.def: Limited by rules, money or circumstances.

flighty--adj.def: Changing interests often and not to be relied on.
flighty--adj.ex: He is too flighty for the job.

averse--adj.def: Strongly disliking or unwilling to accept something.
averse--adj.ex: The bank is averse to risk.

breadwinner--noun.def: The family member who earns the money.
breadwinner--noun.exTr: Evin geçimini sağlayan kişi o oldu.

overlay--verb.def: To place one layer over another.
overlay--verb.ex: Overlay the map with the new borders.

floodgates--noun.def: Gates controlling a rush of water, or of events.

testimonial--noun.def: A written statement praising someone's work or character.
testimonial--noun.ex: Her boss wrote a warm testimonial.
testimonial--noun.exTr: Patronu sıcak bir referans yazısı yazdı.

liaise--verb.def: To work with another group to exchange information.
liaise--verb.ex: We liaise with the local police.

collider--noun.def: A machine that smashes particles together at high speed.
collider--noun.ex: The collider runs beneath the border.

ephemeral--adj.def: Lasting only a very short time.
ephemeral--adj.ex: Fame of that kind is ephemeral.
ephemeral--adj.exTr: Bu tür bir şöhret kısa ömürlüdür.

condensation--noun.def: Drops of water formed when warm air meets a cold surface.

rebuke--verb.def: To speak sharply to someone for what they did.

rebuke--noun.ex: The letter was a public rebuke.

slither--verb.def: To move smoothly along the ground as a snake does.
slither--verb.ex: A snake slithered into the grass.

philanthropy--noun.def: The giving of money and time to help others.

commode--noun.def: A chest of drawers, or a chair containing a chamber pot.
commode--noun.ex: A walnut commode stood by the bed.
commode--noun.exTr: Yatağın yanında ceviz bir komodin duruyordu.

flit--verb.def: To move quickly and lightly from place to place.

inscrutable--adj.def: Impossible to read the thoughts or meaning of.

remorseful--adj.def: Feeling deep regret for something you did.

spire--noun.def: The tall pointed top of a church tower.
spire--noun.ex: The spire is visible for miles.

whir--verb.def: To make a low continuous sound while turning fast.

elation--noun.def: A feeling of great happiness and pride.
